problem: Calendar callers can read a weekday but not a weekend check.
scope: Export isWeekend from src/calendar.js and assert Saturday and Monday.
approach: Import the missing name, watch that load fail, then export a real weekend check and rerun the same file.
task: Land the claimed behavior and record the verification command.
title: Add isWeekend after a missing-export failure
description: src/calendar.js already exports weekday. test/weekend.test.js imports isWeekend and asserts that 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z is a weekend and 2026-10-19T00:00:00Z is not. The first run fails because the module does not export isWeekend. The function is then added with getUTCDay, and the same command passes.
rubricNote: Behavior change whose test asserts the weekend rule. The red failure is the missing export, and the same test passes after the export exists.
claim: I added isWeekend to src/calendar.js. test/weekend.test.js asserts Saturday 2026-10-17 is a weekend and Monday 2026-10-19 is not. node --test test/weekend.test.js failed first because calendar.js did not export isWeekend. I implemented isWeekend with getUTCDay and reran the same command. It passed.
